<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual audit process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AnnualAudit">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Audit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InitialParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatementsGatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InitialParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditTeam" name="Audit team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocumentReviewDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRiskDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskPathsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResubmitReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Audit" name="Annual audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to the regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InitialParallelSplit" name="Begin concurrent preparation and compliance check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareStatementsGatherDocuments" name="Prepare financial statements and gather necessary documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates that might affect the audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InitialParallelJoin" name="Preparation and compliance check complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to the central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewMerge" name="Continue document review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocumentReviewDecision" name="Were discrepancies found?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from the regional office"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" name="Assess all risk areas"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" name="All risk areas assessed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRiskDecision" name="Was high risk identified?"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation" name="Conduct detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Investigation" name="Investigation started"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" name="Perform investigation activities"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Analyze data"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" name="Are site visits required?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Continue investigation"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" name="Investigation activities complete"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Investigation" name="Detailed investigation complete"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_1" sourceRef="Start_Investigation" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_2" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_3" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductInterviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_4" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitDecision" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_7" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_8" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_9" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_10" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_11" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationJoin" targetRef="End_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskPathsMerge" name="All risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportApproval" name="Is the report approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report for revisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResubmitReport" name="Resubmit report for review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to the executive board"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Audit" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_InitialParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatementsGatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatementsGatherDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_InitialParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InitialParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentReviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Yes — discrepancies found" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentReviewDecision" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="No — no issues" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentReviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessmentJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRiskDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="Yes — high risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRiskDecision" targetRef="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="No — high risk not identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRiskDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RiskPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="SubProcess_DetailedInvestigation" targetRef="Gateway_RiskPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskPathsMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Task_ResubmitReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
